description: A photograph displaying a mountainous landscape under a blue sky with white clouds, illustrating the classification of different grassland types relative to the tree line. An orange dashed line indicates the "Tree line" separating dense forest below from a lighter green, less forested area above. Above this tree line, the upper mountain slope is labelled as "Alpine grasslands – 4.2.2". Another orange dashed line further down the slope separates the forest from an area of green pasture closer to a paved road in the foreground. This lower grassland area is labelled "Mountain hay meadows (Semi-natural grasslands without woods plants) – 4.2.1.2". The image is attributed to "©European Union, 2012 LUCAS" (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey).
